title: Decision memo that is right and well supported (clean control)

proof.python:
import csv
rows = list(csv.DictReader(open('evidence/bench.csv')))
r = {int(x['requests_per_sec']): (int(x['p95_ms']), int(x['errors'])) for x in rows}
assert r[800][0] == 12 and 800 / 200 == 4
assert r[1600][0] < 50 < r[3200][0]
assert 1600 / 200 == 8 and 3200 / 200 == 16
